events.summary: Dear players,Ghost Hunting Journal is taking part in Steam Next Fest!Join Jolin and Joe for their first supernatural investigation in our free demo, featuring the first of the full game's three story chapters. Explore a city of urban legends, talk to its residents and solve puzzles as you uncover what's behind the haunting.The demo now includes a hint system to help with certain puzzles, along with important bug fixes. events.title: ✨9/22 Demo Launch
events.summary: Dear players, We are Spicy Games, and Ghost Hunting Journal is our second story-driven adventure game. On September 22, we will officially release the demo version of our game on Steam. Welcome to download and try it for free! The demo includes the complete first chapter of the game (estimated playtime: 1-1.5 hours).
